title: Say Dam ya Amaknol ed sakey a Panarian
intro: Sakey a dalin ya walaan na onaagus iran ilog, duaran berde iran hardin, tan agnaparaan ya inkaaligwas — balet saray manaayam ditan et ag-inmabobon ed samay angibendisyon ed sikara. Nen sinmabi ray panonot ya ontatawag ed sikara, inmarawi ira. Say tinmumbok et sakey a dusa ya anggad natan et singa pasakbay. Siopa iyan kadaanan a komunidad?
clues: Nanayam kami ed dalin ya abendisyonan kanian say ayaman mi et walad baetan na duaran berde iran hardin.
Nanggayagaan mi ray ilog ya onaagus ed saray dalin mi tan say daakan ya ani ya mamapano ed kaabungan mi.
Balet nen tinawag itayon misalamat tan ontulok ed Katawan tayo, tinmunda itayo lapud inkamapaatagey.
Say kayamanan tan inkainomay mi so amawala na lingwanan mi ed samay angiter ed amin.
Insan sinmabi so biglan ilog ya linmabas ed baleg a babeng ya panmamatalkan mi.
Sikami so totoo na Saba', ya say dalin da et kabkabat ed baleg a Ma'rib Dam.

trial.label: Say Inkagba tayo
options: Sakey a maksil a dagem manlapud tawen

outcome.label: Say kapalaran tayo
options: Duaran ampait a hardin so sinmalat ed saray mararakep a hardin mi
Mas lalon binmaleg iray hardin mi
Say dalin et linmereg ed silong na dayat
Niponpon kami ed dapol na bolkan
Say bansa tayo et naapag ed labinduan tribu
outcome.answer: Duaran ampait a hardin so sinmalat ed saray mararakep a hardin mi

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
